summary: Tested Bug 1 (SC Update Preserve Lines) and Bug 2 (hasActiveChild Skip Outsourced Children) fixes for Manufacturing ERP. Both bugs are VERIFIED FIXED. Bug 1: SC orders created via create-sc endpoint (with reference_wo_ids) now preserve their smart-resolved lines during update - charges can be changed without overwriting RM lines. Bug 2: Children with outsourced_by_parent=true are correctly skipped in hasActiveChild check and display 'Covered by parent SC' in UI.
passed_tests: Bug 1: test_sc_update_preserves_smart_resolved_lines - SC lines (PT-1 + RM-1 + RM-2) preserved after PUT /api/job-work/orders/{id} with changed charges
Bug 1: test_manual_sc_order_recalculates_lines_on_update - Manual SC orders (no reference_wo_ids) still recalculate lines correctly
Bug 2: test_children_marked_outsourced_by_parent_on_sc_creation - Child MOs marked with outsourced_by_parent=true after parent SC creation
Bug 2: test_fg_mo_can_show_sc_button_after_sa_outsourced - hasActiveChild correctly skips children with outsourced_by_parent=true
Frontend: Job Work page loads correctly with SC orders showing smart-resolved RM items
Frontend: Manufacturing page shows 'Covered by parent SC' for outsourced children with outsourced_by_parent=true
Frontend: Login with admin@erp.com / Admin@123 works correctly
Regression: create-sc endpoint still works correctly with smart resolution
critical_code_review_comments: Lines 5700-5723 (server.py): update_subcontract_order correctly checks for reference_wo_ids/reference_wo_id before auto-recalculating lines - VERIFIED WORKING
Lines 997-1011 (ManufacturingPage.js): hasActiveChild correctly has 'if (kid.outsourced_by_parent) continue;' to skip covered children - VERIFIED WORKING
Lines 3785-3796 (server.py): mark_children_outsourced function correctly sets outsourced_by_parent=true on child MOs - VERIFIED WORKING

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Job Work and Manufacturing pages working correctly)

seed_data_creation: Test items, BOMs, routings, production orders, work orders, and SC orders created during E2E testing with unique UUID suffixes for isolation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both Bug 1 and Bug 2 fixes verified working. Bug 1: SC orders with reference_wo_ids preserve smart-resolved lines during update (PUT /api/job-work/orders/{id}). Bug 2: hasActiveChild skips children with outsourced_by_parent=true, and UI shows 'Covered by parent SC' for these MOs. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_sc_update_preserve_lines.py
